# v26.0 WP10: Pentarchy Reunion triggers — BYZ/ROM compatible, renewable after 10y cooldown,
# and strict realm/ally/patriarchate/opinion>=100 spread boundary (zero hostile continental leak!).
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_rw_pentarchy_cities_owned = {
    location:rome = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes } }
    location:alexandria = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes } }
    location:antioch = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes } }
    location:jerusalem = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes } }
    location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes } }
}

oe_pentarchy_spread_location = {
    is_ownable = yes
    has_owner = yes
    owner = {
        OR = {
            oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes
            AND = {
                religion = { group = religion_group:christian }
                OR = {
                    any_international_organizations_member_of = {
                        international_organization_type = international_organization_type:autocephalous_patriarchate
                        leader_country ?= { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        country_exists = c:ROM
                        OR = {
                            is_allied_with = { target = c:ROM }
                            opinion = { target = c:ROM value >= 100 }
                        }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        country_exists = c:BYZ
                        OR = {
                            is_allied_with = { target = c:BYZ }
                            opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 100 }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_rw_pentarchy_romanization_started = {
    religion:orthodox = {
        OR = {
            any_movement_in_religion = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_orthodox_identity_movement }
            has_variable = oe_pentarchy_wave_cd
        }
    }
}

oe_rw_start_pentarchy_romanization_allowed = {
    oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_RW_ASSIM_PENTARCHY_NOT_STARTED NOT = { oe_rw_pentarchy_romanization_started = yes } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_RW_ASSIM_PENTARCHY_CONDITION oe_rw_pentarchy_cities_owned = yes }
    custom_tooltip = { text = OE_RW_ASSIM_PENTARCHY_VALID_ORIGIN oe_rw_assim_pentarchy_has_valid_origin = yes }
}
